purpose: Require durable exact-commit verification evidence when a task packet declares source checks, so a committed source mutation cannot be promoted to task/source completion merely because the write itself succeeded.

requirement_grammar.untyped_evidence_requirement: does not create source verification obligation

prerequisites: source outcome binds the exact source mutation binding
source outcome binds the exact ProviderExecutionBinding
source outcome mechanical effect id matches provider:<provider_id>:<provider_effect_id>
source outcome repository/ref/operation/path/destination/previous head match the durable source binding
mechanical effect fence is COMMITTED or RECONCILED_COMMITTED
effect request digest matches the durable source outcome
effect result digest matches the durable source outcome
owning task is still open when new verification evidence is appended
accepted Vera lifecycle/currentness is current before external verification is treated as qualified evidence

observation.stale_head_rule: observed_ref_head != exact mutation outcome new_ref_head => STALE_HEAD regardless of individual check success

task_dependency_semantics.no_matching_SOURCE_VERIFY_requirement: successful source effect + exact durable source outcome may satisfy the source dependency
task_dependency_semantics.task_closeout: blocked while any active dependency is not SATISFIED

restart.latest_observation_reassessed_against: current exact source outcome, current task requirements, and live ref head when PASS is used as current evidence
restart.missing_transport: verification remains blocked; no inferred success

concrete_github_transport.commit_binding: GraphQL repository.object(oid:<exact commit>) with returned oid equality required
concrete_github_transport.duplicate_same_name_contexts: conservative aggregate FAIL > UNAVAILABLE > PENDING > PASS
concrete_github_transport.branch_head: read separately; moved ref becomes STALE_HEAD at SourceVerificationStore
concrete_github_transport.credentials: host injected and not persisted by this mechanism

currentness.github_collection_order: collect exact-commit check contexts, then refresh mutable branch head
currentness.rationale: material ref movement creates a new current source subject; an older PASS remains historical evidence but is not current-source evidence
